message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (filed 2024-11-01, fiscal year ended September 28, 2024) and bought 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $223.00 (filled at $223.00, ~$9,812 total), which sits roughly 0.1% above the current $222.70 quote and is within the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily caps (I placed no other orders today). The decision rested on Apple's total net sales for fiscal 2024 of $391,035 million (up 2% year over year from $383,285 million), with net income of $93,736 million, diluted EPS of $6.08, operating income of $123,216 million, and operating cash flow of $118,254 million — supported by 13% Services growth to $96,169 million and $140.8 billion of cash and marketable securities. No money was moved out of the account; the purchase was funded from the existing $50,000 cash balance, leaving the 100 MSFT shares untouched.
